items.check: Assumptions A1-A4 in label_table.json are acceptable. The final five measurements of B02, B03 and B04 are PROVISIONAL END-STAGE PROXY LABELS: they stand for the end-of-test state of a bearing found damaged after dismantling (description Table 3), not a verified deteriorated state at those measurements. The exact damage onset is unknown (A3). The rig stopping at its vibration or temperature threshold does not by itself prove that the bearing defect caused the stop (A2 is an assumption). The healthy labels rest on 'no defect was initiated' and 'Begin with a new bearing' (A4)
items.source: Dataset description v2 (Aimiyekagbon, 25 Mar 2024, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.10805042) p.2 'No defect was initiated'; p.8 Table 3; logs p.2; A1-A3 have no document (dismantling time not given anywhere)

items.check: SUSPECTED logging/scaling discrepancy, NOT confirmed by the dataset authors: B04's recorded measured speed is 0.498-0.500 x and its peak dynamic load about 0.52 x the set values in every row (static load normal). Our vibration analysis supports, but does not prove, that the shaft ran at the set speed and these two columns were logged at half scale: in 14 files from M0001 to M1114 the shaft-frequency line sits at the set speed, with only background at the recorded speed. Neither the description nor the B04 log mentions it. Data kept as recorded; labels never use speed; the 8 inputs are identical with the speed doubled
items.source: Dataset description v2 (Aimiyekagbon, 25 Mar 2024, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.10805042) p.7 (meanAbs_speed = measured speed, no scale note); B04_log.pdf p.1 (T_high ranges); vibration spectrum (14 files, M0001-M1114)
